book.name: Mark
book.title: Mark Riwana Ahiahina Mark i girugirumiya

content: Yesu rava 4000 i ghamohi
Naꞌi marana patara ghaeghaena hivi tagogi yana meyehi. Patara ahi yam eꞌegha, yamna aubaina Yesu ana tauvotaghotagho i ghorehi da hi naꞌe awarina ma ipa,
“Madegha tonugha au horana, patara maiteꞌu a maꞌae ma ahi yam eꞌegha ma tauhi a rau-nuwapoapoeyehi.
Ana amhiraghehi ana paritawanehi, apo au etanai hina rau-moyaghahu ma ghehauhi uwamei hi neꞌi.”
Ana tauvotaghotagho hi pari-beyei, “Weꞌi mutuyuwa ma mepa yam tana vaini da weꞌi patarana tana ghamohi?”
Ma Yesu tauhi i rau-bayadehi ipa, “Payawa bihagha awarimi?” Tauhi hi riwa, “Seven.”
Ma Yesu patara i riwehi da hi tughura ma payawa seven i vaini ma God ivi egwayauwei ma ivo tomutomuhi ma ana tauvotaghotagho i verehi ma patara hi ghutehi.
Ma tauhi auwarihi iyana muhomuhohi ruwagha, Yesu i vaini, God ivi egwayauwei ma ana tauvotaghotagho i verehi ma tauhi patara hi ghutehi.
Tauhi anatapuhi hi am da hi am hi yauwa. Tauvotaghotagho yam amtereterenana hi tamaꞌaruaruhi da poha seven hivi howai.
Rava ahi magha 4000 nanaꞌarena ivi anihi. Au murina i pari-tawanehi da hi naeme ahi au numa.
Pharisee God ana matakiraha ivi baghei
Maratagogi, Yesu ana tauvotaghotagho maitehi au waga hi geru da hi damana Dalmanuta ana au parata.
Pharisee ghehauhi hi neꞌi Yesu awarina ma maiteni hivi awahegahigahiyana. Tauhi hi ghohei da Yesu hita rau-dadani da matakiraha, Godei itavi heghai.
Yesu aruwanei i yavutu tawanana ma i riwa, “Taumi, tupumuri
ravami, aiwaꞌi aubaina matakiraha o ghoheghohei da ota inanai? A ririwana kauwemi apo matakiraha egha ona i inanai.”
Yesu, Pharisee ma Herod ahi viharaharamana boꞌa, e raꞌaraꞌata me yeast, ona inana vaimahiei
Yesu Pharisee ivo terehi ma ana tauvotaghotagho maitehi au waga hi gerume ma hi damana Galili topana au tupo ghehauna.
Ana tauvotaghotagho nuwanuwahi i vuru da payawa egha hita vaini, payawa tagogi ava au waga i maꞌamaꞌae.
Yesu iparivai nuwa i daghihi “Pharisee ma Herod ahi viharaharamana boꞌa, e raꞌaraꞌata me yist, ona inana vaimahiei.”
Ma tauhi hi dede hipa, “Payawa eꞌegha aubaina e dedede.”
Ma Yesu ahi dede i haramanei aubaina da i riwehi, “Payawa eꞌegha ma aiwaꞌi ovivi tarapiriyei? Taumi yohora egha ota inana tuhaghai bo? Koyami i bagibagi bo?
Matami e maꞌamaꞌae ma egha ota inainana ma tanighami e maꞌamaꞌae ma egha ota nononora bo? Ma o notanotai bo eꞌegha?
Maranaina payawa 5 a votomutomui rava 5000 aubaihi, payawa amtereterenana o tami da poha bihagha ivi howai?” Tauhi hi pari-beyei, “12”
Ma maranaina payawa 7 a votomutomui rava 4000 aubaihi ma payawa amtereterenana o tami da poha ghaeghaehi bihagha ovi howai? Tauhi i pari-beyei, “7”
Ma tauhi i riwehi ipa, “Taumi yohora da ovivi nuwanaina bo?”
Yesu oroto matana apoapoena ivi yawahani au Bethsaida
Tauhi hi neꞌi au Bethsaida ma rava ghehauhi oroto matana apoapoena hi neiyai Yesu awarina ma hivi baghai da matana ita vodadani.
Orotona matana apoapoe i rau-ꞌurana ma meyagaiyei i taravaina hopunei. Ma kampa matana i hovaꞌi ma uranei matana ivo dadani ma i rau-bayadehi, “aiwaꞌi e inainanai bo eꞌegha?”
Ma i tahepai ma i riwa, “Rava a inainanahi ma tauhi me eyagi, he bababara.”
Yesu uranei oroto matana, ivo dadana meyei, matana i yawahana, i ahi ma aiwaꞌi anatapuna inana kauwei.
Yesu tauna i pari-tawanei ana au numa ma i riwei, “Egha au meyagai manaeme.”
Peter ivi hegha da Yesu tauna Keriso
Yesu ana tauvotaghotagho maitehi i nae au meyagaigheha Sisiria Pilipai au gheregherena. Au etanaiyei ma i rau-bayadehi, “Rava he ririwa da Taꞌu aiyaꞌi?”
Ma tauhi hi pari-beyei, “ghehauhi e ririwa da tam John Taubabataito ma ghehauhi he ririwa da Elijah ma ghehauhi he ririwa da peroveta tagogi warihagha maemaena.”
Ma Yesu tauhi i rau-bayadehi, “Wate taumi me o notanotanei ma i riwa da Taꞌu aiyaꞌi?” Peter i pari-beyei, “Tam Keriso, Tauvi yawahana Godei!”
Yesu tauhi ivi ghaehi da egha aiyaꞌi hina riwei da tauna aiyaꞌi.
Yesu ana hiraghe ma ana vomahiri i dedei

Ma Yesu ana tauvotaghotagho vinuwaterenehi ivi kareni ipa, “Rava Natuna inavi nuwaꞌapoapoe kauwa ma Jew babadahi, piripirisi ghehauhi ma raugagayo tauvi haraharamanahi, hina pari-virevirei tauna ina hiraghe ma madegha tonugha au murina inavo mahiri me.”
Yesu didimaninei weꞌi kauwahi ivi heghehi ma yamna aubaina Peter tauna i taravainariyeai ma i pari-virevirei.
Wate Yesu i maetavirei ma ana tauvotaghotagho i inanai ma Peter i pari-ghahiyei, ipa, “Satan manae au muriꞌu! Tam am nota egha Godei ita neneꞌi, eꞌegha da raveꞌi”
Yesu votaghotaghona
Yesu tauna patara ma ana tauvotaghotagho i ghorehi ma i riwehi, “Mepa da aiyaꞌi itavi muritaghoiu, tauna ina boviyana meyei, ana korosi ina avarai ma inavo taghotaghoꞌu.
Aiyaꞌi ravana ana yawahana evo vodidini ma e paꞌipaꞌini apo ina vineboai ma aiyaꞌi da ana yawahana e amverenei taꞌu ma tuyeghaꞌu ahiꞌahina aubaina, tauna ana yawahana ina vaina meyei.
Mepa da wei dobuna ana yawahana ma ana viguyau ina vainapahi ma yawahana Godei ina geduaiyei, wei dobuna viguyauna tauna me ina hagunei?
Wate aiwaꞌiyei am yawahana ma gimara meyei.

Mepa da aiyaꞌi taꞌu ma au viharaharamana inavi hinimayei weꞌi ghohaꞌapoapoehi kauwana au marana, Rava Natuna tauna inavi hinimayei maranaina ana aneya vivivireina maitehi, amana ana borumei hina nenememei.”

footnotes.text: Tupumuri, anona yamna marina tau tupuwa ravahi (Yesu ana au mara) ma egha rava muriyai hita tuputupuwa. Riwa taumi evo vairewapani

Mai Jew ahi au vinuwanotanota, yeast yamna awanaina me apoapoe e raꞌaraꞌatanei. Ma maranai Yesu i riwa ‘Yeast’ yamna Pharisee ma Herod ahi viharaharamana apoapoehi ma yawahana apoapoehi hevivi haraharamanei.

Weꞌi yamna awanaina. Anona yamna Yesu ana Tauvotaghotagho yamna rauiviꞌapoapoe inavi aroni aubaina tauhi, tauna hevo taghotaghoi. Tauna egha ita ririwa da ana tauvotaghotagho au korosi hina hiraghe me tauna.
